title: Copper marks identity and the one primary action per surface, never status
acceptance: Classes row status marks use the caution channel (or no color), not bg-brand.
The Live queue shows at most one copper primary; the other Preflight buttons are secondary.
Landing CTAs are reviewed against §9.1 and the outcome recorded (judgment: header plus hero is a common pattern).
The e2e screenshots at 1440 and 390 show one copper primary on Classes and Live.

evidence.summary: The readiness dot is drawn with bg-brand on every non-Ready row. Checked on main c9b89a7.
Every LiveQueueCard button uses rf-btn-primary. Checked on main c9b89a7.
2026-10-28 owner UX audit of production: Top priorities 5 and 10, and cross-cutting theme 2. Browser evidence; not re-observed at intake.
Owner set Ready on 2026-10-31, relayed from the Air conductor: "Yes, approve both" (RF-137 and RF-135). No separate Ready PR; this lane PR records it.

ClassesHome readiness dot bg-brand -> bg-state-caution (the text label still carries the meaning). LiveQueueCard: only the card leading the ranked queue (orderClassesBy, the class she is most likely to teach next) uses rf-btn-primary, and only once every card has resolved, so copper never hops; the other cards use a cyan secondary. Landing CTAs reviewed against design system 9.1: kept as is, because header, hero and closing buttons are one primary action (Start building / Enter the private beta, all onStartBuilding) repeated at scroll positions, not competing actions.

"gives copper to one Live queue card only, the one leading the queue (RF-135)" (three runnable classes, one rf-btn-primary) and the ClassesHome dot test (bg-state-caution, not bg-brand) both fail on the RF-137 head and pass on the PR.

Local e2e screenshots 2026-10-31: Classes at 1440 and 390 show one copper primary (Create); the 390 row shows the caution Needs tempo dot. Live at 1440 and 390 shows one copper primary (Play). The smoke captures Live mode, not the Live queue list; the queue is covered by the component test.

resolution: Copper now marks identity and one primary per surface (#673): caution status dots on Classes rows, one copper Live queue action (the leading card), landing CTAs reviewed and kept. Owner to accept the two design choices in the PR.
